title: Custom Football Player Holding Ball Close Up Comforter
description:
Transform your bedroom into the ultimate sports haven with the custom footballer comforter set from Jeminise. This soft and lightweight bedding is designed for football lovers, players, and fans, featuring a striking graphic illustration of a football player holding a ball. Perfectly combining style and athletic passion, it adds a vibrant, energetic touch to any kids' room, teen bedroom, or guestroom decor.

Key Features

  • Personalized Design: Customize your bedding with two text inputs, allowing you to add your preferred name and number for a truly unique sports-themed look.
  • Comfort & Warmth: Crafted from 100% brushed polyester fabric with whole-piece microfiber filling that prevents clumping or shifting, providing a super soft and cozy feel in all seasons.
  • Available Sizes: Available in multiple sizes to suit any bed, including Twin (68" x 88"), Full (78" x 88"), Queen (88" x 88"), and King (104" x 88").
  • Included Components: Each set package includes one high-quality comforter (or duvet cover) and optional matching pillowcases.
  • Easy Care: Durable and quick-drying fabric is machine washable in cold water on a gentle cycle; tumble dry on low heat to keep it fluffy.

Product Specifications

Brand Jeminise
Product Type Comforter Set
Material Polyester
Fabric Type Polyester
Fill Material Microfiber
Selected Design Footballer Hold the Ball
Theme Sports: Football
Pattern Football Player Holding Ball
Style Contemporary
Seasons All
Care Instructions Machine wash with cold water, Tumble dry on low heat, Iron on low/medium heat
